sections.title: Unit 29: Cultural Policy and Cultural Institutions in Hungary, 2010–2026
body: This unit follows Hungarian cultural policy from 2010 to the spring of 2026 as a finished period. Five accounts cover the changes in cultural institutions, the Petőfi Cultural Agency, theatre funding, the Hungarian Academy of Arts and the National Cultural Fund, and the debate before the 2026 election.
Each judgement in the texts has a source: the critics, the pro-government side, an institution. Where a matter was disputed, the other side is named too.
